contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: The pack is crowded with large-cap megacap tech names (MSFT, NVDA, AAPL, AMZN, GOOGL) where the dominant signal is disclosure-driven congressional positioning and broad affiliation rather than unusual activity — a picture of steady accumulation by insiders and politicians, not a tight catalyst. The most idiosyncratic convergence sits in MU (insider buying + unanimous analyst upgrade + patent cluster + StockTwits bull) and, to a lesser degree, AMD (8-Ks + analyst cluster + retail buzz), while LUV carries a rare Trump-linked activist buy.

calibration.note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.

signals.thesis: MSFT has the highest convergence score (6) and weighted score (2.25) in the pack, driven by six channels including app demand (4.77 rating, ~20M reviews), GitHub momentum (188,941 stars), HF model momentum (33.6M downloads/30d), patent cluster (318), and lobbying ($3.65M) [app_demand, github_momentum, hf_model_momentum, patent_cluster, lobbying]. The signal is broad affiliation (Sam Altman, Bill Ackman) plus steady congressional accumulation (~$1.05B position) [actor:Sam Altman, actor:Bill Ackman, congress_position_usd]. But this is a disclosure-heavy megacap read rather than unusual activity — every channel is already priced and consensus. Not extended (+12.3pp). WATCH, because there is no idiosyncratic catalyst to buy.

disclaimer: An AI reading of the desk's own deterministic convergence — accountable and checkable, not a guarantee. Every call cites the channels/actors it is based on, is graded vs SPY over the horizon, and can be wrong or overconfident. The Mastermind sizes it through its own risk framework; treat as odds, not a forecast.
